page.layout: One column of running text in the centre-left; in the right margin three marginal notes (Nota at the level of "quorum exempla", and two "Conventio" notes beside "cum FIVELINGIIS" and beside "Episcopus ptomifit"). Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword at the right below the last line; signature "F" at the foot left.

main_text.p: In eodem vero hoc, vt & in tertio euidens indi-dicium extat, paulo ante cum vniuersis FIVEL-GONIIS & HVNESGONIIS in noua pacta & foedus confensisse eandem ciuitatem: quorum exempla periisse dolemus. NotaAnno sequente M. CCCC. XVII, mense Iunio, cum glisceret rumor de consiliis Vltraiectini (cui sederat in animo, Groningam ad iusiurandum sibi dicendum adigere) & viciffim de Occone Broecmerio Kenonis filio aliquid suspicionis effet, cum FIVELINGIIS & HVNESGONIIS Conventio inter civita-tem & agri ordines.conuenit ciuitati, ne pars altera fine altera de cooptando domino consilia iniret: secus fa-cienti bis mille scutatorum veterum poena esset. Et cum biennio post ciuitas importunitate episcopi superata in fidem se eius vel inuita contulisset, agrarij ordines quoq; hi idem, & cum his HVM-MERCII, LONGOWOLDII, FREDOWOLDII, autore ciuitate episcopum etiam eundem pactis conuentis sibi obligarunt: quorum haec summa:

Episcopus ptomisit, iuri, libertati, ditionibus ordinum agrariorum, cu ufmodi tum erant, impedimento se nunquam futurum, modo ipsi vicisim in Vltrajectinos injuriu [?] non sint, & cum ciuitate Groningana in eadem amicitia, societate, & institutis prefentibus permaneant constantes, imo contra oppressores gratia & consilio ipsis adfuturum, item procuratorum, ne quid injuriae à suis, aut per diuisionem suam cuiquam eorum inferatur impunè: nec ullum se castellum vllamvé munitionem excitatu-rum aut recepturum in agro hoc, unde agra-riis ordinibus periculum creari queat. Hoc

page.notes: Right margin: "Nota" (beside the Anno line); "Conventio inter civita-tem & agri ordines" (beside cum FIVELINGIIS); "Conventio inter epifcopum Vltraiect. & ordines agrarios" (beside Episcopus ptomisit, printed over several short lines with hyphenation, placed here as one note; it is set at the head of the Episcopus paragraph and is not repeated in main text). Doubtful readings: "injuriu" (line "Vltrajectinos injuriu non sint") is uncertain, marked [?]; "fe-derat" in parenthesis printed with hyphen; "Vltraiectini" as printed. The line-final "F factum" at the foot is treated as signature F and catchword factum; the catchword is also given in bottom_margin only. Long s rendered as plain s throughout; "vero" and "euidens" kept as printed. No Greek or Hebrew on this page.
